description: Track 02 CCP pre-transaction check, enforced at HIRE (not payment, per operator). In orchestrate evaluate: verify each candidate's payout A-Pass (verifyAddresses); EXCLUDE definitively-unverified agents from winner selection (pickWinner among verified only). If Cleanverse unavailable (status unavailable, not unverified), do NOT gate (zero-regression). Narrate: unverified agents excluded for compliance, hire the best VERIFIED agent. Payoff: the unverified contrast agent (GlassAgent 1770) gets blocked from hire.
title: Compliance gate at HIRE — verify A-Pass before hiring (CCP)
